summary: The library now holds one verified entry: time series momentum (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen 2012), where past 1-12 month returns tend to continue. It is a monthly effect on diversified futures, so its 24-hour value is small and I tilt only 0.02 from 0.50. The tilt follows each instrument's 1-month trend where that trend is clearly one-sided (about 1 sigma or more). Other instruments are left out for lack of evidence.

evidence.claim: Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen find return persistence over 1 to 12 months across 58 futures (equity indices, currencies, commodities, bonds); it is a monthly effect, so only a small tilt applies to 24h.
